device.model: HD-XS2 (Globo) / Blue XS65 (Opticum): one software pack for both
device.soc: ALi M3503 (the bootloader chunk's version "M3503---0.1.0"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build with the chip's internal NIM_S3503 demodulator driver)
device.family: M3503 (chips/m3503.py: the M36xx family with the chip ID 0x3503 and the XIP bootloader's cache-as-RAM stack)
device.demod: internal (NIM_S3503_0 / NIM_S3503_1; the NIM_S3501 driver is in the build too)

image.version: 1.3.5 "SmartHD" (main-code chunk 112000000000002, version 00000135; Libcore 13.8.0@SDK4.0fa.13.8_20150326, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0fa.13.8_20150326; the SEE's uLibcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126)
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (M3503---0.1.0), HDCPKey 0x02EE00 (00000001), MemCfg 0x02F000 (00000001), maincode 0x030000 (chunk "112000000000002" 00000135, LZMA 0x121442 bytes -> 5.2 MB), seecode 0x1D0000 (00000135, LZMA 0xDF6E3 -> 2.9 MB), storage_part 0x2B0000, Radioback 0x2D0000 (1.0.0), ca 0x2DFF80, defaultdb 0x2F0000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x2FFF80 (1.0.0, 0x100070 bytes) -- the whole 4 MB flash

source.note: The manufacturer's software pack Sw_Opticum_Blue_XS65_Globo_HD-XS2_SoftwarePack_1.3.5_2015-06-22.zip (two .abs images and a Polish README: unpack to the USB stick's root, the receiver picks the matching file itself); fetched 2026-10-11 from the mirror's Opticum / INNE folder.

simulator.note: Draws its main menu (the tiles "Edycja kanałów", "Instalacja anteny", "Ustawienia systemu", "Nagrania", "Karta dostępu", "Media player", "Ustawienia dysku") at ~140 M instructions, 363 GE commands; the remote's RIGHT moves its highlight (run_dump_hdxs2_capture_screen.py, 2026-10-14).  What it had waited for: its application's remote call HLD_DSC.16 (0xA0000200, 0xA0297AB0, 5, 0x40000000), in which the SEE hashes the application's code with SHA-256 on the crypto engine (0xB8034000: the DMA at +0x80..+0x94 feeding the SHA unit at +0x300..; crypto_engine.py) -- its driver started the DMA and waited for the done interrupt (line 44, OS IRQ 52), which nothing raised, so the call never returned and the main thread waited for its reply for good.  (The SEE's SHA wrapper, 0x861A6B88, can spin for good after the hash, 0x861A6C34, when a check of its own fails; with the model's real SHA-256 it returns.)  Before: as the M3503 family (2026-10-12, run_dump_hdxs2_app_starts.py): the bootloader runs from the flash window with its stack in the cache-as-RAM range (the Ferguson T750i's kind of bootloader), starts the SEE through the SEE's boot code at 0xA1016804 (chips/see.py), unpacks the main code and starts the application, which moves its exception vectors (EBase 0x80002000) and starts the SEE's program at 0x86000200 on the second core (see.SeeCore; it moves its own, EBase 0x86002000).  Their remote calls use the newer chips' doorbells (the ring in the +0x37 byte): 74 calls answered and 34 of the SEE's by ~55 M instructions; then it prints GPS_FAST_PAIRING--flag_set and idles, no GE command within 90 M (its FD650K panel's pins are not known, so a standby display would not show).  Silent build otherwise: one 0x01 byte to the UART.  (As the plain M36xx family the bootloader pops a return address of 0xFFFFFFFF from the flash, where its stack would be cached, and the CPU faults at PC 0.)  Where it stopped (2026-10-13, read again 2026-10-14): its main thread's call HLD_DSC.16 (#75, ~53 M) was never answered, as in the Reta image -- the two answered HLD_BASE.6 calls after it (#76, #77) came from another task.  The chip's internal demodulator answers its chip ID (chips/m3503.py InternalDemod); nothing is drawn (no GE command on either core).

desc: The official 1.3.5 "SmartHD" update of the Globo HD-XS2 / Opticum Blue XS65 satellite receiver (main code 112000000000002, 2015-05-08), the first ALi M3503 image in the collection: a dual-CPU chip of the S3602 platform with its own SEE co-processor program (the seecode chunk) and an internal DVB-S2 demodulator (NIM_S3503).

Drivers named in the main code: PAN_FD650K (a TM1650-compatible front-panel chip, pins not found yet), HDMI_ALI_E_150303_1, NIM_S3503 and NIM_S3501; its update file names are /c/Sw_Globo_HD-XS2_SmartHD.abs and /c/XS2_SHD.abs, its OTA server ota.globo-multimedia.com.
The pack's second image, Sw_Globo_HD-XS2_Reta_pol_1.3.5_2015-06-22.abs, is the Polish retail build of the same software.
